name: obliview
description: Self-hosted, agent-based network intrusion prevention system (IPS): multi-tenant, hierarchical groups, fleet-wide firewall bans

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server --noEmit && tsc -p client --noEmit && tsc -p server/test/tsconfig.json
scripts.audit: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process');let rc=0;const n=spawnSync('npm',['audit','--omit=dev','--workspaces','--include-workspace-root'],{stdio:'inherit',shell:true});if(n.status!==0)rc=1;const g=spawnSync('govulncheck',['./...'],{cwd:'agent',stdio:'inherit'});if(g.error&&g.error.code==='ENOENT'){console.log('[audit] govulncheck not installed: agent/ check skipped (go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest)')}else if(g.status!==0){rc=1}process.exit(rc)"
